//: Time-boxed waivers for npm advisories with no upstream fix available yet (npm audit reports fixAvailable: false). Each waiver is re-evaluated by dependency-audit-test.sh against review_by; once that date passes the finding fails the build again until a maintainer confirms it's still unfixable and bumps review_by, or the dependency is updated/removed.

waivers.reason: All published versions of image-size, including the latest (2.0.2), are within the vulnerable range — no patched release exists upstream yet. The vulnerable ICNS/JXL/HEIF parsers belong to @netlify/dev-utils' local-dev image tooling and are never invoked by any KubeStellar Console serverless function at runtime.
